demo_chips: How much does a maintenance plan cost?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Browns Heating & Cooling at (708) 536-8134 or support@brownshvac.net, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: Is there a sign-up or cancellation fee?
faqs.a: No. There is no sign-up fee and no cancellation fee, so you can join without any risk.

faqs.q: Do I have to schedule my own tune-ups?
faqs.a: No. Once you are a member, we take care of scheduling your maintenance visits, so your systems never miss their service.
Members earn a $100 per year loyalty credit, up to $1,000, toward a system replacement.

pricing.summary: Maintenance plans are priced per system: furnace, AC and boiler tune-up plans are $10.99 per month, a high-efficiency boiler plan is $12.99 per month, and a water heater plan is $9.99 per month - a single furnace/AC system runs $239.88 per year. There's no sign-up fee and no cancellation fee, and members get 25% off all repairs, a 5-year parts warranty on repairs, waived service fees and no overtime fees.
